channel.title: Comments for page "My Hell"
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "My Hell"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
A skip that actually loves the Foundation for containing it? Thats a pretty inclusive club.
Immortality approach may be overdone, but this one definitely earns my +1

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I don’t know, I much preferred the explanation given in the article itself. I mean, he can talk to people around him normally, do why wouldn’t he just tell all of this to the foundation if this was really his life?
I guess I just want the guy who got his strange, personal happy ending to keep it.
Especially since, in my opinion, people cursing their immortality are really overdone. I thought the original article was a clever twist on that.
-1

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: So I can't do Staff Posts or calls for review or anything, but the Random Tale button just led me to this short, sweet, and simple gem from the site's creepypasta days and I figured I'd bring it to the attention of people lurking in Recent Posts. I'm just gonna say that I'm kinda surprised some of the old Series I stuff gets ignored like it does— why aren't there more tales about this guy and 007 and the like?

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: This is wonderful. I think i'm not the only one who knows exactly what he/you are speaking of when he speaks of his own personal hell.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: If this was explicitly about 076, I'd be upvoting. Since it's not, no vote. It's not interesting enough on its own.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: That's how I would take it; he believes he has cursed to turn into concrete and live forever, so it's perfectly reasonable that he'd think that someone or something cursed him.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: To be fair, since his state of being is all in his head, that pact could very well have been too…

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: But the phrasing is still a little strange. Either way, the original article is supposed to make him seem like more of a result of self-induced belief of turning into concrete than a Faustian pact of immortality, but this takes a nice angle to the story. No canon and all that, yeah.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: The real reason Able is so angry at humans is because somebody keeps playing Kenny G. in the containment room.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: It would be an…unconventional approach to 076, certainly. Interesting, though. Very interesting.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: …Wow. I never thought of it that way. Believe it if you like.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I was going to downvote for being inspecific and perhaps cliched, but then I thought (since I didn't read the first paragraph first off for some reason), oh god, what if this is about 076?
That sort of blew my mind, even though it's not your intention, so I'll stay my vote.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Oh, you happen to be very, very right.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Some of the phrasing is a little stilted, but I figure that's intentional. Overall not bad, and bringing attention to the less well-known SCP's is always nice. I approve.

(SCP-014 unless I'm very, very wrong.)
